subject.title: Add Message Rate Limiting for Feishu Channel

question: Should Feishu add the opt-in `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` configuration proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96513, or should proactive pacing remain automatic or unsupported beyond the existing retry behavior?
rationale: The implementation is plugin-local, but adding a durable configuration knob and choosing its default and inheritance semantics are compatibility-sensitive product decisions that source inspection cannot settle.

options.title: Sponsor opt-in pacing
options.body: Accept per-target plugin-owned pacing with top-level and per-account overrides, default zero, complete send-surface coverage, and live Feishu burst proof before merge.

options.title: Prefer automatic pacing
options.body: Request a Feishu-owned adaptive or fixed safe policy without a new public config key, with upgrade-latency evidence and an escape path if required.

options.title: Keep retry only
options.body: Reject the new pacing surface, close the linked pull request, and document reactive retry plus existing chunk and streaming controls as the supported behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor opt-in pacing
recommendation.body: Accept per-target plugin-owned pacing with top-level and per-account overrides, default zero, complete send-surface coverage, and live Feishu burst proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: m1heng is the clearest Feishu plugin ownership signal and is already engaged on this specific request.
